collections.name: Science Fiction
collections.description: Classic and modern science fiction: desert planets, galactic empires, cyberspace and the future.

books.title: Dune
books.author: Frank Herbert
books.description: On the desert planet Arrakis, young Paul Atreides is drawn into a war over the most precious substance in the universe.

books.title: Foundation
books.author: Isaac Asimov
books.description: A mathematician foresees the fall of the Galactic Empire and sets up a plan to shorten the dark age that follows.

books.title: Neuromancer
books.author: William Gibson
books.description: A burned-out hacker is hired for one last job in cyberspace. The novel that started cyberpunk.

books.title: The Left Hand of Darkness
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.description: An envoy visits Gethen, a frozen world whose people have no fixed gender, and must learn to trust one of them.

books.title: Fahrenheit 451
books.author: Ray Bradbury
books.description: Guy Montag is a fireman whose job is to burn books, until he starts reading them.

books.title: The Martian
books.author: Andy Weir
books.description: Left behind on Mars, astronaut Mark Watney has to survive with science, duct tape and a sense of humour.

collections.name: Crime & Mystery
collections.description: Detectives, hard-boiled private eyes and modern thrillers.

books.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.description: Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson investigate a family curse and a ghostly hound on the moors of Devon.

books.title: Murder on the Orient Express
books.author: Agatha Christie
books.description: A passenger is stabbed on a train stuck in the snow, and Hercule Poirot has twelve suspects.

books.title: The Big Sleep
books.author: Raymond Chandler
books.description: Private detective Philip Marlowe is hired by a rich general and pulled into the dark side of Los Angeles.

books.title: The Maltese Falcon
books.author: Dashiell Hammett
books.description: Sam Spade chases a priceless statuette through San Francisco after his partner is shot.

books.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
books.author: Stieg Larsson
books.description: A journalist and a brilliant hacker look into a disappearance that happened forty years ago.

books.title: Gone Girl
books.author: Gillian Flynn
books.description: On their fifth wedding anniversary, Amy disappears, and every clue points at her husband Nick.

collections.name: Poetry
collections.description: Great poets, from the 19th century to today.

books.title: Leaves of Grass
books.author: Walt Whitman
books.description: Whitman's life work, a celebration of the self, the body, democracy and America.

books.title: The Flowers of Evil
books.author: Charles Baudelaire
books.description: Les Fleurs du mal: poems of beauty, decay and the modern city that changed French poetry.

books.title: Ariel
books.author: Sylvia Plath
books.description: The fierce last poems Sylvia Plath wrote, published after her death.

books.title: The Complete Poems of Emily Dickinson
books.author: Emily Dickinson
books.description: All 1,775 poems by Emily Dickinson, short and strange, about nature, death and the inner life.

books.title: Milk and Honey
books.author: Rupi Kaur
books.description: Short poems about love, loss, trauma and healing, with drawings by the author.

books.title: Devotions
books.author: Mary Oliver
books.description: Mary Oliver's own selection of her poems about animals, the natural world and paying attention.

collections.name: Nature Writing
collections.description: Essays and memoirs about forests, birds, the land and our place in it.

books.title: Walden
books.author: Henry David Thoreau
books.description: Thoreau's two years living simply in a cabin by Walden Pond, in the woods of Massachusetts.

books.title: Silent Spring
books.author: Rachel Carson
books.description: The book that revealed the damage done by pesticides and launched the environmental movement.

books.title: A Sand County Almanac
books.author: Aldo Leopold
books.description: A year on a Wisconsin farm, and the case for a land ethic that treats nature as a community.

books.title: Pilgrim at Tinker Creek
books.author: Annie Dillard
books.description: A year of close watching in a valley of Virginia's Blue Ridge Mountains. Pulitzer Prize 1975.

books.title: H is for Hawk
books.author: Helen Macdonald
books.description: After her father's death, the author trains a goshawk, a wild and difficult bird of prey.

books.title: Braiding Sweetgrass
books.author: Robin Wall Kimmerer
books.description: A botanist and member of the Potawatomi Nation brings together science and Indigenous knowledge of plants.
